findings.title: Artifact digest does not match the attested subject
findings.subject: dist/guardian_app-1.4.3-rc1-py3-none-any.whl
findings.remediation: Quarantine the artifact and rebuild it from a trusted, verified workflow.

findings.title: Downloaded content is piped directly to a shell
findings.subject: release step 2
findings.evidence: The run command executes network-fetched content without integrity verification.
findings.remediation: Download, verify a pinned digest or signature, then execute from a trusted path.

findings.title: Critical-severity vulnerable component
findings.subject: build-helper@latest
findings.evidence: Fixture maps this component to SYNTH-2026-0007 (critical).
findings.remediation: Upgrade, remove, or isolate the component after validating reachability.

findings.title: Dependency name resembles a protected package
findings.subject: reqeusts@99.0.0
findings.evidence: Observed 'reqeusts' while the expected package is 'requests'.
findings.remediation: Quarantine the package, verify the publisher and lock the intended dependency.

findings.title: Build provenance is not signed
findings.subject: dist/guardian_app-1.4.3-rc1-py3-none-any.whl
findings.evidence: The demo attestation has no recorded signature.
findings.remediation: Generate and verify a Sigstore-backed artifact attestation.

findings.title: Attestation is absent from the transparency log
findings.subject: dist/guardian_app-1.4.3-rc1-py3-none-any.whl
findings.evidence: Transparency log inclusion is false or missing.
findings.remediation: Verify inclusion and identity with the platform attestation verifier.

findings.title: Artifact was produced by an unexpected builder identity
findings.subject: dist/guardian_app-1.4.3-rc1-py3-none-any.whl
findings.remediation: Block promotion and verify repository, workflow, and OIDC identity claims.

findings.title: Workflow grants write-all permissions
findings.subject: workflow permissions
findings.evidence: Top-level permissions is set to write-all.
findings.remediation: Set read-only defaults and grant narrow job-level permissions.

findings.title: Privileged pull_request_target trigger is enabled
findings.subject: workflow trigger
findings.evidence: The workflow runs in the base repository context for pull_request_target.
findings.remediation: Use pull_request or strictly separate untrusted checkout from privileged steps.

findings.title: Secret is interpolated directly into a shell command
findings.subject: release step 3
findings.evidence: A GitHub secret expression appears inside run:, increasing log and injection risk.
findings.remediation: Pass secrets through a narrowly scoped environment variable and avoid echoing them.

findings.title: New publisher identity coincides with a download spike
findings.subject: reqeusts@99.0.0
findings.evidence: Publisher age is 2 days and the synthetic download ratio is 34.0x.
findings.remediation: Require maintainer verification and provenance before promotion.

findings.title: Dependency version is not pinned
findings.subject: build-helper@latest
findings.remediation: Resolve and lock an immutable dependency version and hash.

findings.title: Untrusted workflow can reach a self-hosted runner
findings.subject: release
findings.remediation: Use isolated ephemeral runners and restrict which triggers can reach them.

findings.title: Third-party action is not pinned to a full commit SHA
findings.subject: release step 1
findings.remediation: Pin the action to a reviewed 40-character commit SHA.

findings.title: Third-party action is not pinned to a full commit SHA
findings.subject: release step 4
findings.remediation: Pin the action to a reviewed 40-character commit SHA.
